issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be implemented as public for easier testing, but both the template and the solution declare this method as private (and the template version is missing the Animal parameter). This visibility mismatch can prevent tests or students from calling the helper method externally as requested and will cause confusion or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of singFarmSongVerse to public and ensure it accepts an Animal parameter (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)). Update both the template and reference solution accordingly so the method matches the problem statement and can be used by tests or external callers.
